reason_for_human: All five occurrences mean 'priest/kohen', drawing on the same verse cluster (Malachi 2:7 'שפתי כהן', Hosea 4:6 'מכהן לי', 'אתה כהן לעולם'). The vocalization variants — כֹּהֵן/כֹּהֲנִים (noun sing./plur.) and מִכַּהֵן (infinitive 'to serve as priest' in Hosea 4:6) — are inflections of one word, not homographs. The differing bechina partners (chesed, ahava, Torah, tefilla, Avraham) are context-dependent symbolic identifications, not separate lexemes.
